sources.entry: Colanode - Collaboration suite with real-time messaging, rich text pages, file management, and dynamic databases - built for offline work (alternative to Slack, Notion). (Source Code) Apache-2.0 K8S/Docker

summary.one_liner: Colanode is an open-source, local-first collaboration workspace combining real-time chat, rich text pages, customizable databases, and file management, which can be self-hosted.
summary.what_it_does: Provides instant messaging for teams and individuals, a Notion-like rich text editor for documents, wikis and notes, and databases with custom fields and table, kanban, and calendar views. It stores and shares files within workspaces. Changes are saved to a local SQLite database first and synced to the server by a background process, so work continues offline. Pages and database records use Yjs-based CRDTs for concurrent editing, while messages and file operations use simpler database tables. Clients are a web app or desktop app, and one client can connect to multiple servers, each holding several workspaces.
how_to_run: cd apps/server && cp .env.example .env && npm run dev
notable: Local-first design: edits save to local SQLite and sync later, so offline use works
Real-time concurrent editing on pages and database records via CRDTs (Yjs)
Pluggable file storage: local filesystem, S3-compatible, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage
Configuration via a config.json with env:// and file:// references for secrets
Official Docker Compose and Helm chart deployment options
caveats: Self-hosting requires Postgres with pgvector and Redis, plus a storage backend, so setup involves several services
The web app is in early preview and may have bugs or browser compatibility issues
Cloud servers are free beta; pricing is yet to be announced
